Agentive subjects are marked within Series II. However, agentivity does not necessarily trigger ergativity, e.g. in Series III (Hewitt 1990:338).

Non-agentive A takes ergative marking in Series II. Hewitt (1990, pp.187-189) provides multiple examples of inanimate/abstract agents with no volitional control taking the ergative case: sun-ERG (dried the field), sweat-ERG (penetrated the shirt), pleasure-ERG (made me dizzy), God-ERG (let you grow old), illness-ERG (weakened the man’s knees). These are Series II constructions and therefore take the ergative. Original annotation (value=0) was a coding error directly contradicted by the examples cited in the same comment.
